messages:
morgan: quick UX check — noticed a visual overlap when you drag a rule up/down in the left rail. the drop indicator sits under the floating rule card and it's hard to tell where it'll land. loom: https://loom.example/abc123 :eyes:
lee: ah yeah saw that — drag ghost has no shadow and the list items don't shift until mouseup. feels jumpy.
anya: also the tiny helper text under the 'match' field reads 'required' which is unhelpful. users kept asking what exactly to put there. suggestion: change to 'Add a request matcher (path, header, or method)'.
rafael: +1 on copy. can we make validation toasts less cryptic too? current says: `invalid selector` — no clue which rule. maybe include rule name/id and which field failed.
morgan: good call. proposal for toast copy: `Rule "{name}" — match expression is missing. Click to open rule.`
lee: for the drag overlap — simple fix: add z-index and a dashed drop placeholder that pushes items down as you drag. tiny prototype:
```
.drop-placeholder { height: 48px; border: 2px dashed var(--muted); transform: translateY(0); }
.dragging .rule-card { box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); opacity: .98; }
```
anya: can we also add an aria-live region announcing reorder actions? keyboard users need to know when a rule moved. e.g. "Rule X moved to position 3".
rafael: accessibility nit: the current focus ring disappears when you click the overflow menu — focus doesn't return to the rule item after closing. screen reader stops following.
morgan: good catch. accessibility checklist for this thread: 1) visible drop placeholder + animation, 2) aria-live reorder announcements, 3) explicit focus restore after menus, 4) clearer validation copy with link-to-rule.
anya: one more tiny copy tweak for the rules list empty state: current 'No rules yet' -> change to 'No routing rules yet — click "Create rule" to start matching requests.' helps set next action.
lee: UX question — should the rule card show a condensed preview of match conditions inline? it might reduce clicks when ordering. small mock: name line + badges for `path:/api/*` `header:x-env` `rate>0`
rafael: I like condensed badges, but make sure they have title/tooltips for full expression and that they collapse on narrow widths.
morgan: ok action items: @lee try CSS placeholder + shadow prototype and post screenshot, @anya and @rafael to update ARIA/focus flows and draft revised copy, i'll wire the toast change with link-to-rule. aim to ship in the next tiny sprint.
dev-ex-bot: reminder — design review sync scheduled Thu 10:30. Add agenda: drag reorder demo, validation copy, a11y checklist.
anya: noted. i'll add the agenda and include a11y repro steps.
lee: posting prototype in #design-patches shortly :thumbsup:
rafael: thanks all — looks straightforward. :rocket:
